rows.label: Study notes
rows.text: **Natural speech.** Lines should sound spoken — short sentences, everyday vocabulary, contractions and questions — rather than formal written prose.  ·  **Punctuation.** Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks, and a new paragraph begins whenever the speaker changes.  ·  **Consistency.** Keep each speaker's tone, vocabulary and personality consistent throughout the exchange.
